description: Cyclist occlusion conflict (edge case 05) on yale-street: car, truck, wrong-way cyclist and pedestrian replayed from the render timeline through scen-play --authored-height. Gates: pass hashes, a non-vacuous instance-ID pass, and observed actor transforms within the Bevy parity profile of the timeline sampler. Two-wheelers are drawn without their rider (--allow-riderless-two-wheelers, recorded as actor-model-substitution): scen-play draws rigid parts and cannot pose the skinned rider, so this golden keeps guarding the bike geometry; the ridden look is covered by native-render-service.
